rv.q: But presenting all three as unremitting backstabbing bastards does make it difficult to care about them.
For everyone else, this is political drama of the highest calibre that deserves a West End showcase.

cn.t: Critics praise Gang of Three as a witty, cerebral dissection of Labour Party power struggles, brought to life through sharp writing and strong performances. A nostalgic yet fascinating glimpse into political skullduggery.
